newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shanghai Ind says reviewing projects.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Ind says reviewing projects.

text.p: Shanghai Industrial Holdings Ltd responded on Tuesday to a report it may take a stake in a Chinese highway venture by saying it has been reviewing certain projects in accordance with its business development plans.
"However, no agreements have been made in relation to the acquisition or any other acquisitions which are notifiable," the company said in a statement.

Shanghai Industrial said it made the statement in response to a report in the Hong Kong Economic Times newspaper on Monday on the company's possible acquisition of a 50 percent interest in the Shanghai Inner Ring Elevated Highway project.
The statement did not deny the report or give any other information.
